name: Popl
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description: Popl is the AI GTM platform for in-person events — the data layer for everything that happens face-to-face. Powered by AI and its proprietary data engine, Popl helps companies worldwide turn events into a measurable, scalable growth channel: universal badge scanning, AI-powered conversation recording, real-time data enrichment, and automatic CRM sync.
one_liner: Your AI GTM platform for In-Person Events
